subject: A group photo of eight distinct toy-like cartoon dinosaurs, representing different tooth types

Long neck curving gently, friendly expression.
Low to the ground, armored, looking inquisitive.

visual_logic.style_notes: STYLE_ANIMATED_FEATURE_V3; consistent 'rounded, toy-like' proportions; vibrant, kid-friendly colors; friendly expressions. Ensure smooth, matte plastic-like textures. The focus is on them as a happy, cohesive group.
